title: Filipino-Style Tinola
description: A comforting and flavorful Filipino chicken ginger soup made with ginger, onions, and garlic.
instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the ginger, onion, and garlic and sauté until the onion is translucent.
Add the chicken and cook until browned.
Add the bay leaves, black peppercorns, fish sauce, and tinola powder.
Pour in the chicken broth and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes or until the chicken is cooked through.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the tinola with steamed rice.
